questions.text: A system has 3 processes sharing 4 resources. If each process needs a maximum of 2 units, then
questions.solution:
Worst case: each of the 3 processes holds 1 unit (3 used). The 4th unit lets one process reach its maximum of 2, finish, and release its units, and so on.

(In general no deadlock if total [latex]\ge[/latex] n(max [latex]-[/latex] 1) + 1 = 3 [latex]\times[/latex] 1 + 1 = 4.)

Answer: Deadlock can never occur

Deadlock needs a circular wait: each process holds something another one needs. With only one resource, whoever holds it can finish and release it, so others just wait. No deadlock in any of these cases.

Answer: none of these

questions.text: At a particular time of computation the value of a counting semaphore is 7. Then 20 P operations and x V operations were completed on this semaphore. If the new value of semaphore is 5, x will be
questions.solution:
Each P decreases and each V increases the value by 1:
[latex]7-20+x=5\Rightarrow x=18[/latex]

Answer: 18

questions.text: Let the page fault service time be 10 ms in a computer with average memory access time being 20 ns. If one page fault is generated for every [latex]10^6[/latex] memory accesses, what is the effective access time for the memory?
questions.solution:
Fault rate p = [latex]10^{-6}[/latex], fault service = 10 ms = [latex]10^7[/latex] ns.
EAT = (1 [latex]-[/latex] p) [latex]\times[/latex] 20 + p [latex]\times[/latex] [latex]10^7[/latex] [latex]\approx[/latex] 20 + 10 [latex]\approx[/latex] 30 ns.

The closest option is 29.9 ns.

Answer: 29.9 ns

questions.text: Consider a non-negative counting semaphore S. The operation P(S) decrements S, and V(S) increments S. During an execution, 20 P(S) operations and 12V(S) operations are issued in some order. The largest initial value of S for which at least one P(S) operation will remain blocked is ________.
questions.solution:
With initial value x, the 12 V operations can supply at most 12 more units, so at most x + 12 P operations can succeed. For at least one of the 20 P operations to stay blocked: [latex]x+12 \lt 20\Rightarrow x\le7[/latex].

Answer: 7
